說明: 《千秋硯》卷三〈阿瑪納〉生圖清單（回一～回二）。畫風、節點、尺寸沿用卷一清單。注意：阿頓與阿蒙都不醜化，妖物是人心所化、不是神本身；建築依阿瑪納的考古復原（白色泥磚、平屋頂），不要金字塔與獅身人面像。

items.name: 阿肯塔頓
items.prompt: Ancient Egypt around 1346 BC, the new city of Akhetaten (Amarna) on the east bank of the Nile in Middle Egypt: a city being built in the desert under a blazing white midday sun: rows of new whitewashed mud-brick walls rising from the sand, workers carrying small stone blocks on their shoulders, wooden scaffolds and ropes, a wide shining river to the west lined with a narrow strip of brilliant green fields and palm trees, a long line of pale yellow cliffs to the east, a huge open-air temple of many courtyards without roofs in the distance. Architecture as in archaeological reconstructions of Amarna: flat-roofed buildings of sun-dried mud brick plastered and whitewashed, simple rectangular shapes, wooden doors, palm-trunk beams; people wear plain white linen kilts and simple linen dresses, men with short-cropped hair, bare feet or reed sandals. No pyramids, no sphinx, no camels, no domes, no arches, no minarets.

items.name: 邊界石碑
items.prompt: Ancient Egypt around 1346 BC, at the foot of a pale yellow limestone desert cliff under harsh sunlight: a large flat rectangular panel being carved into the cliff face, at its top a relief of a round sun disk sending down many long straight rays that end in tiny open hands, below it rows of small worn carved pictures too faint to read; wooden scaffolds lashed with rope against the cliff, fine white stone dust drifting in the air, sand at the bottom. Workers with copper chisels and wooden mallets: Egyptian workmen of the New Kingdom: short-cropped black hair or shaved heads, clean-shaven, bare-chested, wearing short plain white linen kilts wrapped at the waist; no long hair, no headbands, no feathers, no beads. Any carved signs are Egyptian hieroglyph pictures (small birds, eyes, reeds, water lines, human figures) worn and blurred; absolutely no Chinese characters, no Asian script, no Latin letters.

items.name: 工人村
items.prompt: Ancient Egypt around 1346 BC, the new city of Akhetaten (Amarna) on the east bank of the Nile in Middle Egypt: a small walled workers' village in the desert at golden late afternoon: identical narrow mud-brick houses in straight tidy rows along narrow lanes, flat roofs with drying laundry, firewood, clay pots and a girl grinding red pigment on a stone slab, a low mud-brick enclosure wall around the village, sand all around, cliffs behind. Architecture as in archaeological reconstructions of Amarna: flat-roofed buildings of sun-dried mud brick plastered and whitewashed, simple rectangular shapes, wooden doors, palm-trunk beams; people wear plain white linen kilts and simple linen dresses, men with short-cropped hair, bare feet or reed sandals. No pyramids, no sphinx, no camels, no domes, no arches, no minarets.

items.name: 雕刻作坊
items.prompt: Ancient Egypt around 1346 BC, a sculptor's workshop courtyard in Amarna with whitewashed mud-brick walls and a reed-mat awning casting soft shade: wooden shelves holding many white plaster face casts of men and women with closed eyes, blocks of limestone; on a low bench, simple ancient tools only: slim copper chisels with no handles, rounded wooden mallets shaped like clubs, smooth stone polishers, and a few small open clay bowls and sea shells holding lumps of red ochre, green malachite and black soot pigment; on a table at the back a painted limestone bust of a woman with a long graceful neck wearing a tall flat-topped blue crown, one eye inlaid and the other eye left blank; quiet and dusty, warm light. No modern hammers, no pliers, no steel tools, no artist's paint palette.

items.name: 阿頓大神廟
items.prompt: Ancient Egypt around 1346 BC, the new city of Akhetaten (Amarna) on the east bank of the Nile in Middle Egypt: inside the Great Temple of the Aten: a vast open-air courtyard with no roof, flooded with intense white sunlight, hundreds of small square offering tables of whitewashed mud brick and stone arranged in long straight rows, each piled with bread, fruit, flowers and lotus blossoms, tall gateway towers (pylons) with tall wooden flagpoles and red pennants, people in white linen, almost no shadows anywhere. Architecture as in archaeological reconstructions of Amarna: flat-roofed buildings of sun-dried mud brick plastered and whitewashed, simple rectangular shapes, wooden doors, palm-trunk beams; people wear plain white linen kilts and simple linen dresses, men with short-cropped hair, bare feet or reed sandals. No pyramids, no sphinx, no camels, no domes, no arches, no minarets.

items.name: 採石場
items.prompt: Ancient Egypt around 1346 BC, a limestone quarry cut into a pale desert cliff under a merciless noon sun: stepped white rock faces with long straight grooves cut by chisels, wooden wedges hammered into the cracks, workers cutting and carrying identical small rectangular stone blocks each the length of a forearm, stacks of these small blocks, blinding white light reflecting from every surface, no shade anywhere, heat haze.

items.name: 摩斯
items.prompt: A 16-year-old Egyptian boy stonemason of the Amarna period, lean and sun-darkened, short-cropped black hair, a plain white linen kilt, white stone dust on his arms and shoulders with small scratches, a copper chisel tucked into his belt, a wide open grin showing one small pointed canine tooth, cheerful and warm.

items.name: 梅芮
items.prompt: A 15-year-old Egyptian girl of the Amarna period, short black hair under a plain linen headscarf, a simple white linen dress, a smear of red ochre on one cheek and green malachite on the other, a reed pen tucked behind her ear, sharp clever eyes and a stubborn little smile.

items.name: 沙魅
items.prompt: A twisting column of golden desert sand as tall as a person, spinning like a small whirlwind, a vague shape of grasping arms forming in the sand, grains glittering in harsh sunlight.

items.name: 熱浪
items.prompt: A shimmering, wavering shape of heat haze rising from white ground, like a mirage of water given a vague human outline, pale orange and white, distorting the air around it.

items.name: 銅鑿靈
items.prompt: A cluster of worn ancient copper chisels with blunted edges and green verdigris, floating together and pointing outward like a bristling creature, flakes of white limestone dust around them.

items.name: 刮痕
items.prompt: A small creature formed from thin pale fibers of papyrus scraped off a sheet, frayed and hairy, drifting like a wisp of smoke, with faint smudges of black ink on it, sad and fragile.

items.name: 半名
items.prompt: A ghostly figure made of grey smoke and frayed papyrus fibers, its face only half there, the other half missing as if scraped away with a knife, several more half-faces drifting around it, eerie and sorrowful.

items.name: 無影
items.prompt: A towering figure of blinding white and pale gold light without any shadow, its outline made of layered heat shimmer and glare, faint shapes of many exhausted workers dissolving within it, oppressive and overwhelming, not a god, not a sun disk.

items.name: 改名
items.prompt: Ancient Egypt around 1346 BC, the new city of Akhetaten (Amarna) on the east bank of the Nile in Middle Egypt: evening in the workers' village square, a plump scribe sits at a low table with a papyrus roll unrolled on his knees, scraping a line of writing off the papyrus with a small knife; a foreman with a staff stands beside him; a crowd of workers watches in silence; in front, a 16-year-old boy stonemason with a copper chisel in his hand, his smile frozen on his face; long shadows, sorrowful. Architecture as in archaeological reconstructions of Amarna: flat-roofed buildings of sun-dried mud brick plastered and whitewashed, simple rectangular shapes, wooden doors, palm-trunk beams; people wear plain white linen kilts and simple linen dresses, men with short-cropped hair, bare feet or reed sandals. No pyramids, no sphinx, no camels, no domes, no arches, no minarets.

items.name: 影子
items.prompt: Ancient Egypt around 1346 BC, a white limestone quarry under the noon sun: a 15-year-old girl in a white linen dress has tied her linen headscarf between two wooden wedges to make a tiny patch of shade, an exhausted old worker rests against the rock inside that small shadow drinking from a water skin, a 16-year-old boy stonemason kneels beside him, a young man and a translucent young woman with long ink-black hair stand nearby; harsh white light all around the one small shadow, tender.

items.name: 尼羅河船
items.prompt: Ancient Egypt around 1343 BC, a long wooden Nile cargo boat of the New Kingdom sailing south on the wide calm brown-green Nile: a shallow, slender hull whose bow and stern both sweep up in long smooth plain curves ending in simple rounded wooden tips, like the boats painted in Egyptian tombs; one tall mast with a single wide rectangular linen sail stretched between two horizontal yards, filled by the north wind; two large steering oars at the stern; coils of rope, baskets and clay jars on deck; narrow bright green strips of fields and palm trees on both banks and pale desert beyond, clear sky. The ends of the boat are plain smooth curves: no carved animal heads, no dragon head, no figurehead, no Viking or Chinese style.

items.name: 底比斯
items.prompt: Ancient Egypt around 1343 BC, Thebes (Luxor) on the east bank of the Nile: the riverfront before the vast temple complex of Karnak: massive sloping stone gateway towers (pylons) carved with reliefs, tall wooden flagpoles, a pair of slender granite obelisks whose pointed tips gleam with gold, a sacred lake with green stagnant water and a few untended lotus leaves; the temple forecourt eerily empty, no priests, no crowds; date palms, the Nile in the foreground, hot afternoon light. No pyramids, no sphinx.

items.name: 卡納克神廟
items.prompt: Ancient Egypt around 1343 BC, Thebes (Luxor) on the east bank of the Nile: inside a courtyard of the temple of Amun at Karnak: sandstone walls and thick columns covered with carved and painted reliefs of a king making offerings, many spots on the walls freshly hacked out leaving rough pale white chiseled scars, wooden scaffolds against the walls, copper chisels and stone dust on the ground, weeds growing between paving stones, harsh sunlight and deep shadows.

items.name: 卡納克內殿
items.prompt: Ancient Egypt around 1343 BC, deep inside the temple of Karnak at night: a narrow dark stone sanctuary with heavy columns, faint moonlight from a slit in the roof, at the far end a small empty stone shrine niche where a statue once stood, a faint outline left on its floor and a few dried flower petals, profound silence and emptiness.

items.name: 帕瑟
items.prompt: A very old Egyptian priest of Amun of the New Kingdom, thin and frail, completely shaved head, deeply lined face, eyes closed as if reciting from memory, bony hands folded; he wears ancient Egyptian priestly linen: a long, finely pleated, semi-transparent white linen kilt-robe tied high at the waist, with a pleated linen shawl draped over the shoulders and knotted at the chest, yellowed with age; no crossed collar, no kimono, no wrap robe with lapels, not East Asian monk clothing; dignified and bitter.

items.name: 鑿痕
items.prompt: A crawling creature made of rough pale chisel scars and chips of sandstone broken off a temple wall, bits of old red and blue paint still on some chips, shaped like a line of erased writing come alive.

items.name: 柱影
items.prompt: A tall dark shadow shaped like the space between two massive carved temple columns, with faint whispering figures of kneeling worshippers inside it, dim and melancholy.

items.name: 河霧魅
items.prompt: A drifting figure of cold white morning river mist rising from tall papyrus reeds, its shape like a small boat with a sail dissolving into fog.

items.name: 蓮影
items.prompt: A tangle of blue lotus flowers and long green stems rising from stagnant green pond water, the stems reaching out like grasping vines, petals half closed, beautiful and eerie.

items.name: 卡納克的回音
items.prompt: A swirling translucent column of many faint singing faces of men, women, elders and children overlapping, made of pale sandstone dust and echoing sound waves, rising inside an empty temple, sorrowful and haunting.

items.name: 空龕
items.prompt: A small empty stone shrine niche from which pours a heavy dark void, a hollow emptiness with a faint outline where a statue once stood, dried flower petals and wisps of old incense smoke drawn into it, profound and sad, not a god, no figure inside.

items.name: 鑿名
items.prompt: Ancient Egypt around 1343 BC, Thebes (Luxor) on the east bank of the Nile: a 19-year-old Egyptian stonemason with short-cropped black hair and a white linen kilt stands on a wooden scaffold before a carved sandstone temple wall, a copper chisel raised in his hand but frozen, staring at a carved oval royal name frame (cartouche) on the wall whose inside is worn and blurred; below, a young woman painter with a reed pen and a young man look up at him; the wall around shows large carved figures of people in profile and fresh white chisel scars; harsh light, tense and solemn. Any carved signs are Egyptian hieroglyph pictures (small birds, eyes, reeds, water lines, human figures) worn and blurred; absolutely no Chinese characters, no Asian script, no Latin letters.

items.name: 暈船
items.prompt: Ancient Egypt around 1343 BC, on a wooden Nile boat under a tall linen sail, exactly four figures, two male and two female. On the left, a lean 19-year-old Egyptian youth with short-cropped black hair leans far over the side of the boat, gripping the rail, seasick with a queasy face, yet laughing weakly; a young man in plain clothes pats the youth's back. In the centre, clearly a GIRL: a 15-year-old Egyptian girl with a soft feminine face, short black hair under a plain white linen headscarf, a long white linen dress, a smear of red ochre on one cheek and green malachite on the other, a reed pen tucked behind her ear, laughing at the youth while holding a flat white limestone flake. On the right, standing a little apart, a ghostly young woman who is clearly not of this world: her whole body semi-transparent and faded like a wash of pale blue-grey ink, the sail and river visible through her, her long ink-black hair dissolving into wisps of ink at the ends, watching the youth with quiet recognition. Green riverbanks and desert beyond, bright and warm.
